desc: Implement `can(L)` DP: exact DP over final-run state `g[i][b]`, optimized to O(n) via prefix-count identity `P_0[j]+P_1[j]=j+1` and dual monotonic deques for sliding-window minimum of `Q_b[j] = g[j][b] - P_b[j]`.
Add binary search over `lo = 1`, `hi = n`, returning the first `L` with `min_flips(L) <= numOps` (`L = n` always feasible with 0 flips, so search terminates).

Handle edge cases: `numOps = 0` fast path (current longest run), `numOps >= n` fast path (answer 1 via alternating target), `n = 1`, sentinel `j = -1` for whole-prefix runs, and correct window eviction (`lo = i - L + 1`) with no empty-deque risk.

Validate against examples and tricky cases by hand: all three samples plus `"0110"` with `L=1` (needs 2 flips — the case where the per-run greedy `sum(len//(L+1))` fails), `"0110"` with 2 ops, and `"000"` with 1 op; independently re-derived the DP transition algebra and traced the deque state for `"0110", L=1`, confirming `min_flips = 2`.
Document complexity: O(n) feasibility check via monotonic deques, O(n log n) total with binary search (~11k ops for n=1000), O(n) memory — improving on the originally planned O(n² log n).
